openClinicalQuestions: Dr. Zalak: any WHD-specific trimester handout timings that differ from the NHS/POGP supine wording?
Dr. Charmi: preferred list of obstetric conditions that must pause class attendance in this practice.

claimLedger.claim: Start new exercise gently; do not start new vigorous activity such as running; change activity as bump grows; avoid lying flat on back more than a few minutes later in pregnancy; stop if uncomfortable, too hot or unwell.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Exercise in pregnancy · Media last reviewed: 3 February 2026
claimLedger.limitations: UK guidance; local Indian maternity limits may be stricter for complications.

claimLedger.claim: Account for joint laxity, balance change and oxygen need; prefer walking, swimming, stationary cycling, modified yoga/Pilates; avoid hot Pilates and fall-risk sports; stop for listed warning signs.
claimLedger.sourceSection: ACOG · Exercise During Pregnancy (FAQ119) · Last updated: September 2024; Last reviewed: November 2025
claimLedger.limitations: US patient FAQ; confirm antenatal advice locally.

claimLedger.claim: Avoid lying on back after 20 weeks for listed supine exercises; prop upper body or use alternatives; seek obstetric clearance with listed contraindications.
claimLedger.sourceSection: POGP · Pilates in Women’s Health Physiotherapy · Publication date on landing page: 29 Nov 2022; PDF © POGP 2018, 2022 for review 2025
claimLedger.limitations: UK physiotherapy booklet; exercise lists are examples, not a WHD class plan.
